compensations.rationale: He cannot take a round away from anyone, so he has to win every one of them on the outside. The reach is what pays for the missing power: it is the attribute that lets him bank rounds he could never end.

severe_negative_consequences.visible_consequence: Clean, correct punches that move nobody - the other man walks through the best shot of the round and the crowd notices before the judges do.

vulnerabilities: cannot hurt anyone: negative power means rounds must be won on volume and accuracy, never taken away
thin durability and a poor chin - the accumulation model catches up with him faster than with anyone he fights
loses the argument entirely if he is trapped on the ropes or in the corner
